feeds.title: Psychedelics Today Blog
feeds.description: Psychedelics Today is dedicated to exploring and discussing the important academic/scientific and other research in the field of psychedelics. We are interested in how psychedelics and other non-ordinary states of consciousness relate to the human potential as well as the healing potential that they can foster.

feeds.title: Third Wave Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to our blog! Read about various psychedelics and their influence in mainstream society. Get breaking news and updates from the world of psychedelia.

feeds.title: Australian Psychedelic Society
feeds.description: The Australian Psychedelic Society is an organization seeking to connect Australia's psychedelic community to benefit, enjoy, and contribute to their culture in a safe and supportive environment. They share the latest Psilocybin, LSD, and MDMA articles and research, community events, and updates on their blog.

feeds.title: Psychedelic Integration
feeds.description: Despite a chaotic childhood I was blessed to encounter psychedelics in my youth. Auspiciously, I completed a Masters degree in Transpersonal Psychology.Now as a trained Transpersonal Therapist, I help you melt fear and resistance for rapid evolution. As an Ordained Minister, I understand that being human is a spiritual practice.

feeds.title: Psychedelic Tips
feeds.description: Covers articles on first-hand mushroom trip reports, safety and dosage information, and the most up-to-date legalities around psychedelic usage. Psychedelic Tips is home to the top education for people who are interested in exploring the world of psychedelics.

feeds.title: The Psychedelic Blog
feeds.description: Each week, you will receive a think piece about the impact Psychedelics have on life, death, grieving, culture, relationships, time, reality, and so on. By incorporating my own experiences with Psychedelics — I can share how a Psychedelic journey challenges our preconceived notions of what it means to have a human experience. I hope the stories I tell make you think, wonder, live & love a little bit more.

feeds.title: Microdose Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to shift the world's perception of psychedelic medicine. Microdose distributes and create the most compelling content, financial analysis, engaging events, and groundbreaking education to drive the psychedelics industry into the forefront of modern medicine.Keeping a pulse on the heartbeat of the psychedelic industry.

feeds.title: Sociedelic
feeds.description: Covers the latest breaking news and videos straight from the psychedelic news, research, and happenings around the study of psychedelics as tools of healing, recovery, and therapy. Sociedelic is a non-profit community dedicated to promote knowledge and responsible use of psychedelic compounds and provides journalism on natural therapies and medicines to enhance the mind, body, and spirit.

feeds.title: Psychedelic Overground Blog
feeds.description: Psychedelic Overground blog is a collection of musings on psychedelics and their relationship to content marketing & copywriting, leadership, and ethics. From insights on microdosing to stories about using psychedelics for healing and transformation, this blog is focused on exploring the potential of these powerful substances in our lives.

feeds.title: Kahpi Magazine | The Ayahuasca Hub
feeds.description: We bring together ayahuasca experts from science and medicine, anthropology and ethnobotany, and shamanism and alternative healing networks. We offer academic and real-world information about ayahuasca in easy-to-understand language. Kahpi publishes academic, esoteric and real-world knowledge about ayahuasca in language that ordinary people can understand. We aim to create a bridge between indigenous and local knowledge and academic and popular thought.

feeds.title: Diaspora Psychedelic Society Blog
feeds.description: We are a values-driven psychedelic society that promotes personal growth and self-development through the use of sacred medicines and psychedelics. Enjoy our growing collection of resourses on everything related to psychedelics and entheogen use from ancient medicinal use, spirituality then and now, and the incredible healing properties as evidenced in recent studies.

feeds.title: Psychedelic Scene Magazine
feeds.description: The mission of Psychedelic Scene is to celebrate, share, and publicize psychedelic music and culture in an effort to bring together a global psychedelic community. We believe it's important to conduct business in a fair and honest manner.

feeds.title: Chacruna Institute
feeds.description: Chacruna media is a collective of researchers and luminaries of psychedelic plant medicine culture, science, and spirituality. The Chacruna Chronicles are dedicated to producing current, relevant and fact-based content that explores a variety of social, political, cultural, and scientific topics and highlights critical issues that are generally outside the psychedelic mainstream, such as diversity, access, cultural appropriation, conservation, regulation and commodification.

feeds.title: The Daily Psychedelic Video
feeds.description: The Daily Psychedelic Video is the biggest collection of curated psychedelic videos on the web. The site is run by a team of psychedelic video aficionados dedicated to finding the best psychedelic videos out there. It has been active daily since April 2010 and includes more than 3,000 psychedelic videos. Dedicated to the exploration of psychedelic aesthetics in cinema, TV, commercials and web videos, the DPV was created so that any person in the midst of a mind-blowing psychedelic experience can have easy access to high-quality psychedelic material.

feeds.title: Lucid News
feeds.description: Lucid News provides informed, honest and transparent journalism that covers the growing integration of psychedelics into society and their broad implications for human wellness. Founded by longtime participants of psychedelic communities who bring discernment and a healthy skepticism to their work, we offer news and opinion from a wide range of perspectives to help readers navigate this pivotal moment of innovation and transformation.

feeds.title: Psymposia
feeds.description: Psymposia offers leftist perspectives on drugs, politics, and culture making sense of the complex connections between drugs, science, capitalism, policy, and culture.

feeds.title: The Pearl Psychedelic Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Pearl Psychedelic Institute is a nonprofit that aims to bring psychedelic-assisted psychotherapy & MDMA-Assisted Psychotherapy into mainstream practice through research, treatment, PTSD therapy, and training while reducing the barriers to patient access. Check out the research, news and more from us.

feeds.title: It's Psychedelic Baby Magazine
feeds.description: An independent, music magazine covering a wide range of alternative, underground and mostly non-mainstream musics. It's Psychedelic Baby is an independent music magazine. A place where musicians can express themselves. We are covering different genres of alternative, underground as well as mainstream artists. Exclusive interviews, reviews, articles and premieres. We serve an international readership. Founded in 2010 by Klemen Breznikar.

feeds.title: Psychedelic Passage Blog
feeds.description: We are trip sitters who facilitate in-person ceremonial psychedelic experiences throughout the U.S. with an emphasis on safety & harm reduction. Our knowledge base features research-based psychedelics, education, news, and how-to articles with actionable advice. Our online learning community helps you connect with like-minded individuals and grow together.

feeds.title: JAMES JESSO
feeds.description: James W. Jesso is the author of Decomposing The Shadow: Lessons From The Psilocybin Mushroom and the host of Adventures Through The Mind. He writes stories to inspire personal insight, essays to educate supple minds, and books to build new conceptual paradigms of reality. He speaks in the open domain, weaving his storytelling tendencies beyond written language and onto vibrational winds to open the hearts of those who choose to listen.

feeds.title: Multidisciplinary Association for Psychedelic Studies
feeds.description: Stay informed MAPS practices the principle of Open Science, Open Books, and transparently sharing what we learn. Through our publications, we seek to Be the Bridge, building common knowledge between the medical, the mystical, the marginalized, and the mainstream. Founded in 1986, the Multidisciplinary Association for Psychedelic Studies (MAPS) is a non-profit organization specializing in research and education. Our work develops medical, legal, and cultural shifts so people can benefit from the careful use of psychedelics and marijuana for mental health, well-being, and connection.

feeds.title: The Psychedelic Society
feeds.description: We are about more than just psychoactive substances. We subscribe to the broader, original meaning of 'psychedelic' - a 'soul-revealing' or 'mind-manifesting' experience that can come through many means. We are passionate about sharing knowledge on the integrated use of psychoactive substances in service of individual and collective transformation. Learn the characteristics of different psychoactive substances, how they interact, and the safest and most beneficial ways to use them.

feeds.title: PsyPost
feeds.description: Reporting the latest scientific research on behavior, cognition and society

feeds.title: Think Wilder
feeds.description: Think Wilder focuses on three tools that can be used to become your best self and build a better world: psychedelics, spirituality, and technology.

feeds.title: New Amsterdam Psychedelic Law Blog
feeds.description: An open-source thought experiment in psychedelic law and policy. My priority is immediate safe and equitable (affordable, culturally-relevant, and non-exploitative) access to a psychedelic experience for anyone anywhere who could benefit from it.

feeds.title: GayLynn.net
feeds.description: I am a Licensed Mental Health Counselor, Certified Addiction Professional, and experienced Psychedelic Therapist trained through the MDMA-assisted therapy program at the Multidisciplinary Association for Psychedelic Studies (MAPS). I assist my clients with preparation and counseling, legal psychedelic medicine journeys, and integration sessions on their inner path to healing.

feeds.title: The Psychedelic Store Blog
feeds.description: Take a closer look at the enigmatic world of psychedelic substances in nature as The Psychedelic Store's blog delves into culinary explorations of these magical mushrooms and other plants. The Psychedelic Store is an online cannabis dispensary selling a variety of recreational products both in packaged and natural form across the United States.

feeds.title: Green Market Report » Psychedelics
feeds.description: The Green Market Report focuses on the financial news of the rapidly growing cannabis industry. Cultivating the Industry's Financial, Business, and Economic News into one source. Follow to get psychedelics news briefs, analytics, portfolios, videos, and reports.

feeds.title: Psychedelic Frontier
feeds.description: Psychedelic Frontier is a blog dedicated to safe and responsible consciousness exploration.Psychedelics stand among humanity's greatest tools: they strip away barriers to self-knowledge and reveal the interconnected nature of all things. It's time we stopped jailing people for choosing to use these medicines.

feeds.title: Tim Ferriss Blog » Psychedelic Drugs
feeds.description: Tim Ferriss's 4-Hour Workweek and Lifestyle Design Blog. Tim is an author of 5 #1 NYT/WSJ bestsellers, investor (FB, Uber, Twitter, 50+ more), and host of The Tim Ferriss Show podcast.

feeds.title: SYNTHESIS Blog
feeds.description: Synthesis offers legal, medically supervised, and scientific-based psychedelic retreats in Amsterdam. We make the psychedelic experience accessible for curious individuals who want to utilize moderate-to-high doses of psilocybin truffles to catalyze creative breakthroughs, explore consciousness, find meaning, improve confidence, and search for a mystical experience.

feeds.title: Psychedelic Somatic Institute
feeds.description: PSI is a Psychedelic Therapy Training Institute providing cannabis and psilocybin-assisted psychedelic training and therapy. Explore A collection of the latest articles, videos, and news in the world of psychedelic psychotherapy at Psychedelic Somatic.

feeds.title: PsyCann Advisors Blog
feeds.description: PsyCann's cannabis consultants are with you every step of the way, helping your business navigate the complex regulatory environment and thrive. Our outstanding cannabis consulting group brings our signature blend of knowledge, innovation, and a deeply client-first attitude to ensure that your business is both competitive and up to regulatory expectations. Check out our blog to know more about psychedelic policies, regulations and more!

feeds.title: Psychedelic Water Blog
feeds.description: Enhance your experience and see the unseen with the Psychedelic Water blog. Psychedelic Water is the first legal psychedelic brand of its kind built on the ethos that psychedelics are more than something you consume; 'psychedelic' is a state of mind that fuels creators, mavericks, groundbreakers, risk-takers and free-thinkers. We are spreading the gospel of psychedelics and developing mainstream products that leave you with a tongue-tingling feeling of happiness, mental clarity, and creative bliss.

feeds.title: Psychedelic Science Review
feeds.description: The latest research updates on the chemistry, neuroscience, and psychology of psychedelics. Psychedelic Science Review (PSR) was founded in 2018 by a small group of scientists committed to improving the quality of and access to scientific information about psychedelics. Concerned about the dearth of accessible and reliable scientific information about psychedelics, widespread misinformation, and poor analysis and conclusions drawn from otherwise high-quality research, our team set out on a mission to address these concerns.

feeds.title: Psychedelic Adventure
feeds.description: Visit our website for more insightful and enlightening posts on Shamanism, Consciousness, Psychedelics, UFOs, Aliens and much more! Our mission is to help us re-connect with all aspects of our self, the one self as we usher in a new paradigm - a new way of life on Earth.

feeds.title: PsychedelicTimes
feeds.description: Explore the Psychedelic Research, Plant Medicine & Entheogen Resource. Our mission at Psychedelic Times is to share the latest news, research, and happenings around the study of psychedelics as tools of healing, recovery, and therapy. We are passionate about the incredible potential that psychoactive substances such as marijuana, ayahuasca, MDMA, LSD, iboga, psilocybin, and DMT present to humanity, and are excited to share that passion with you.

feeds.title: Psychedelic Alpha
feeds.description: We provide information, research, news and interviews from the emergent psychedelic sector in one place. The latest news, analysis and exclusive interviews from the psychedelic sector. Cut through the shroom stock noise.

feeds.title: VICE » psychedelics
feeds.description: VICE is the definitive guide to enlightening information. Subscribe and get everything related to Psychedelics.

feeds.description: A blog with comprehensive information about everything related to psychedelics, psychedelics-assisted therapy, and related experiences.

feeds.title: Harris Sliwoski » Psychedelics Law Blog
feeds.description: The Psychedelics Law Blog is a forum for discussing the practical aspects of psychedelic law and how it impacts those involved in this growing industry. all around the world. With over a decade in business, we know how important it is to understand our clients' businesses and goals. We rely on our strong client relationships, our experience and our professional network to help us get the job done.

feeds.title: Maps of the Mind Blog
feeds.description: A resource website and blog covering psychedelics, meditation, and personal growth. I'm John Robertson, the creator behind Maps of the Mind. I'm a psychedelic educator and guide with experience in the fields of mindfulness, meditation and personal growth.

feeds.title: Psychedelic Experience
feeds.description: Your trip starts here. Check out our guides to psychedelic substances, tips for creating the ideal set and setting, basic safety guidelines, and more. Psychedelic Experience (PEx) is a comprehensive online resource for information surrounding psychedelic substances. We are a community based non-profit organization, created by and for psychedelic and plant medicine communities. Our mission is to support and facilitate global healing and personal growth through safe, responsible and legal use of plant medicines and psychedelic-assisted treatments.

feeds.title: The Buena Vida Psilocybin Retreats Blog
feeds.description: The Buena Vida is the diverse and exciting offerings of Amanda Schendel that inspires others to elevate to their happiest state and highest self. We provide education, information and guidance about your healing with psychedelics.

feeds.title: Reality Sandwich
feeds.description: Bringing you fresh, insightful and delicious bites of all topics psychedelic. Whatever psychedelic means to you, Reality Sandwich gathers the world's most curious and informed minds and provides a vast landscape for you to explore where you belong.

feeds.title: Dr. Bronner's Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Bronner's is a family business committed to making socially and environmentally responsible products of the highest quality and dedicating our profits to help make a better world. All-One!

feeds.title: Brooklyn Psychedelic Society Blog
feeds.description: Exploring the healing nature of psychedelics through the community. Our mission is to make psychedelic healing a publicly accessible good through community, education, democratic ownership, and advocacy.

feeds.title: MIND Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The MIND Foundation is an organization that promotes psychedelic research and education. Our work builds on the neurobiological and psychological potential of psychedelics to improve mental health. We envision a healthier, more connected world through evidence-based, safe, and legal applications of the psychedelic experience

feeds.title: Psychedelic Spotlight
feeds.description: Psychedelic Spotlight is your reliable source for the latest stories in the emerging psychedelics industry. Our mission is to help people obtain a reliable source for the latest stories in the emerging psychedelics industry, covering breakthrough discoveries, investor news and cultural reform.
